text_blocks.snippet: The ICD-10-CM code J45.998 is the diagnosis code for Other asthma. This code is used when a patient's asthma doesn't fit into the other specific categories of asthma, like mild intermittent, mild persistent, moderate persistent, or severe persistent asthma, according to ICD-10 Data.

list.title: ICD-10-CM:
list.snippet: This refers to the International Classification of Diseases, Tenth Revision, Clinical Modification. It's a system used by healthcare professionals to classify and code diseases and other health problems for statistical and administrative purposes.

list.title: J45.998:
list.snippet: This is the specific code for "Other asthma," meaning it's a diagnosis code for asthma that doesn't fall under any of the other more specific J45 codes.

list.title: Other asthma:
list.snippet: This category includes various types of asthma that don't fit into the other, more specific categories. It could be a type of asthma not otherwise specified or a combination of factors.

list.title: Exclusions:
list.snippet: The code J45.998 excludes certain conditions, such as detergent asthma (J69.8), miner's asthma (J60), wheezing NOS (R06.2), and wood asthma (J67.8), as well as asthma with COPD (J44.89) and chronic asthmatic bronchitis (J44.89).
